cards.hint: Focus on what the document created after signing.
options: established the government of the United States
revised the Articles of Confederation
adjourned from day to day until a quorum
cards.quote: signed on September 17, 1787, established the government of the United States
cards.stem: What did the four-page document signed in September do?

cards.hint: Think of the hall where the meeting gathered.
options: Philadelphia
Boston
Charleston
cards.quote: convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787
cards.stem: In which city did the Federal Convention convene?

cards.hint: Remember the earlier plan the delegates meant to fix.
options: to revise the Articles of Confederation
to draft an entirely new frame of government
to elect representatives directly by the people
cards.quote: in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation
cards.stem: Why did the Federal Convention first meet in Philadelphia?

cards.hint: Consider the balance between center and states.
options: how much power to allow the central government
how to punish delegates for secrecy
how to name the new capital city
cards.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
cards.stem: What was one chief point at issue during the debates?
